about.title: Acting for the education of <hl>underprivileged</hl> children
about.lead: Restoring hope to the most vulnerable.
about.quote: We believe that God's love, expressed through tangible actions, transforms lives.

who.title: A humanitarian, apolitical, Christian-inspired NGO
who.text: HOPE International Project is a humanitarian, non-profit, apolitical organisation inspired by universal Christian principles such as love, compassion and mercy. Based in Douala, it also works in Yaoundé, Dschang and the villages of western Cameroon.
who.welcome: We invest in the dreams, health and dignity of the most underprivileged, with compassion, expertise and sustainable commitment. Together, we are more than an organisation — we are a community united by compassion, action and hope.
commitments: Promoting inclusive and equitable education for underprivileged children
Providing medical, psychological and social support to the most vulnerable (sick people, people with disabilities, the elderly)
Supporting young single mothers through empowerment and training
Assisting communities in gaining access to clean water and basic services
Addressing major humanitarian challenges through campaigns and fieldwork
who.verseIntro: Founded on Christian values of love for one's neighbour, justice and service, our NGO acts in response to the biblical call:
who.imageAlt: Members of HOPE International Project, in white polo shirts and caps, in front of the banner “We invest in humanity”

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To promote access to quality education for underprivileged children and meet the essential needs of the most vulnerable, restoring hope, dignity and joy. Through tangible, compassionate actions inspired by our Christian faith, we work toward a more just and inclusive future.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: We believe in a world where every human being, without distinction, has access to equitable education, quality healthcare, and an environment that fosters personal and community development.
vision.education: We view education as a powerful tool for individual and collective transformation.
vision.faith: Our faith in God drives us to see each person as precious, created with purpose, and worthy of love.

faith.title: Faith
faith.text: Our actions are guided by our trust in God and our commitment to doing His will.

equity.title: Equity
equity.text: Reducing inequalities in access to fundamental rights.

compassion.title: Compassion
compassion.text: People are at the heart of everything we do.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.text: Sustainable action is the foundation of change.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: We act with integrity and accountability.

motto.slogan: A better future begins with an act of compassion.

actions.title: Five areas of <hl>action</hl>
actions.text: Each of our actions is a response of love and faith, inspired by the Gospel and Christ's example of service.

education.title: Education
items: Distribution of school supplies and educational materials
Individual educational sponsorship through to job integration
Support for teachers in fulfilling their vocation

social.title: Social and humanitarian support
items: Practical training (sewing, hairdressing, farming, mechanics, construction…)
Economic integration to help them meet their own and their children's needs
Assistance for the elderly, sick and disabled (social inclusion)

water.title: Water access and sanitation
items: Access to drinking water in remote villages

community.title: Community development
items: Project to create the HOPE Academy (school, library, recreation area, canteen, infirmary…)
Training for volunteers and local leaders

upcoming.title: What we are <hl>preparing</hl>
upcoming.text: To go further, the organisation is preparing new actions, which will come to life with the support of its members, donors and partners.

academy.title: The HOPE Academy
academy.text: A school with a library, recreation area, canteen and infirmary, giving underprivileged children a complete learning environment.

water.title: Wells and boreholes
water.text: Building drinking water points in remote villages and raising awareness of community hygiene.

entrepreneurship.title: Social entrepreneurship
entrepreneurship.text: Building on the cheques given to women on 8 March: small start-up funds, business follow-up and, in time, solidarity savings and microcredit groups for single mothers.

training.title: Training and economic integration
training.text: Sewing, hairdressing, farming, mechanics, construction: practical training so that young single mothers can meet their needs with dignity, and training for volunteers and local leaders.

president.name: Mabelle NZEMTCHOU FOTSO
president.text: She leads the organisation with the board, members and volunteers, in the service of children and the most vulnerable.

closing.title: Together, we bring <hl>HOPE</hl> to life
closing.text: Thank you for being part of this beautiful human journey. Each member is essential to bringing light, education and dignity to those who need it most.
closing.blessing: May God bless every step we take in service of others.
